Formulated Without Parabens, Fragrance, Allergens, Alcohol, Mineral Oil, Testing on Animals How to Use Lightest Mineral Sunscreen SPF50+ ? Step 1 Apply evenly to face, neck and ears as the final step of your skincare routine, 15 minutes before sun exposure. Important Information To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this Lightest Mineral Sunscreen SPF50+ regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it Suitable for • All skin types Helps • Protect skin from UVA and UVB rays • Deeply hydrates skin • Improve skin tone • Targets and heals acne • Leaves skin feeling smooth Clinical Proof Lab Tests and Certifications In Vivo SPF Test View Certificate In Vitro SPF Test View Certificate Non Irritant Test View Certificate What makes us STAND OUT?
